label: Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to POTENCY_2 at a first being, from pure actuality
meaning: If every first being is in potency in no respect, then whatever first being is in potency in a respect (none is) is simply posterior to a being in act in that respect. Registers the existing Control.Facts item 3 of ActPriorityAtFirst as an argument, so that every derivation of the q.3 a.1 conclusion (composition, Theta.8, plenitude, act priority) also supports the first-being version. Given non-overlap the two are equivalent. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
